processes.meter_flow_missing_deal_setup: Scheduling or volume management asks the deal owner to create or extend a deal ticket so metered flow with no or expired deal can be allocated.
processes.deal_data_correction_request: A desk asks the deal owner to correct or confirm a deal's volume, price, rate or counterparty in the system so reports and errors balance.
processes.meter_imbalance_unaccounted_for_reconcil: Analysts compare measurement, OSS/UA4 and pipeline numbers to find and correct volume discrepancies or unaccounted-for gas.
processes.gas_control_shutin_notice_handling: Gas control announces meter shut-ins or outages and downstream groups check contracts and notify producers.
